name: Pension Holzknechthof
beschreibung: The Pension Holzknechthof is located in the center of Neustift im Stubaital, not far from the Stubaitalstraße and within walking distance of the ski area. The guesthouse combines traditional Tiroler hospitality with a personal, quiet atmosphere. Guests can expect cozily furnished rooms, a breakfast typical of the region, and a terrace with a view of the Stubaier Alpen.
